name: Cashlytics
description: Cashlytics is a self-hosted personal finance application with an AI-powered assistant. Track accounts, categorize transactions, forecast spending, and manage recurring payments — all with your data staying on your own infrastructure.

notes.text: Create your account on first access. In Single-User Mode only the first registration is accepted.
AI features (assistant, receipt scanner, CSV import) require an OpenAI API key set in /opt/cashlytics-ai/.env.
Edit /opt/cashlytics-ai/.env to configure SMTP email, locale, currency, and notification schedule. Restart with: systemctl restart cashlytics
